_note: WHICH WAVE TABLE BELONGS TO WHICH LEVEL, and nothing more yet. It exists because level 2 stopped sharing level 1's waves and something has to say so; it is data, and no scene reads it. GameScene still loads waves.json directly and is still single-level on purpose — making it level-aware is a separate refactor and is not approved.
_lane: laneLengthPx is the walked length of the painted road, summed over the level's waypoints. Level 1's is measured from map.json; level 2's was given with the plate. It is recorded because wave spacing is only comparable between levels that walk the same distance, and the two here differ by 3.0%, which is not enough to retune.
_unlock: level 2 opens once a run has been cleared, which Save.runsCleared already counts. Nothing enforces it yet — there is no level select — so this records the intent rather than implementing it.
